CustomField.description: Maximum model invocations allowed for one run, or for each reply of a conversational agent.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Maximum model calls for one run. For an agent with Wait for Reply, the limit applies to each reply. Use a whole number from 1 to 9,999. When the next step would exceed the limit, the run pauses; increase the budget and rescue it to continue.
CustomField.label: Max Model Calls
